user_story.capability: each station facility advisory as a stop-scoped alert
user_story.benefit: a station's board can display it

criteria.behavior: emit each parsed station advisory as an alert whose informed-entity stop identifier is the advisory's station code resolved to its GTFS stop

criteria.trigger: a station advisory's station code resolves to no GTFS stop
criteria.behavior: skip that advisory and record a diagnostic rather than emit an alert against an incorrect stop

user_story.capability: each route-level service advisory as a route-scoped alert
user_story.benefit: any train or board of the affected route can display it

criteria.behavior: emit each parsed passenger advisory as an alert whose informed entities are the advisory's affected route names resolved to GTFS route identifiers

criteria.trigger: a passenger advisory affects more than one route
criteria.behavior: include one informed entity per resolved route

criteria.trigger: a passenger advisory's route name resolves to no GTFS route
criteria.behavior: omit that route and record a diagnostic rather than emit against an incorrect route

user_story.capability: each advisory alert to carry its title, detail, and active window

criteria.trigger: the Service emits an advisory alert
criteria.behavior: set its header text to the advisory title and its description text to the advisory title together with the effective-date text

criteria.trigger: an advisory's effective dates parse to a definite start-and-end range
criteria.behavior: set the alert's active period to that range

criteria.trigger: an advisory's effective dates do not parse to a definite range
criteria.behavior: omit the active period and retain the effective-date text in the description

user_story.capability: advisory alerts to ride in the same coherent generation as the existing alerts
user_story.benefit: consumers get one authoritative alerts feed

criteria.behavior: include the advisory alerts in that generation's alerts feed alongside the existing trip-scoped ASM alerts

criteria.trigger: advisory alerts are added to a generation
criteria.behavior: preserve every existing trip-scoped ASM alert in that generation

user_story.capability: advisory scraping to never break the feed
user_story.benefit: a website change or outage cannot stop the service from publishing

criteria.behavior: publish the generation with no advisory alerts and record a diagnostic, without failing generation publication

criteria.trigger: the advisories page cannot be parsed into the expected structure
criteria.behavior: emit no advisory alerts and record a diagnostic without failing generation publication

user_story.capability: advisory alerts delivered through the existing feed without contract changes

criteria.behavior: deliver advisory alerts only through a generation's existing alerts artifact, without adding or changing any feed route or the immutable-generation contract
